answer: The shale debit happens at intake, vertex totals the burned amount, and ledge anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm thus forfeits the burn once for every alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 19 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. Each impostor pays 4 dollars up front. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
